evidence.reason: The CLI accepts `--seed` independently of the phase, and the visible dispatch routes both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` to the same `drain_refuse_phase(args)` handler without any phase-to-seed validation. Unlike the adjacent matrix-boundary check, a conflicting `--seed` is not rejected before dispatch, so `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` can run the ambiguous probe while the phase label still drives the evidence filename. Deriving the seed from the phase or rejecting a conflicting seed is a small compatibility-preserving fix.
